caseName: Dallas Labor Temple Ass'n v. Cureton
caseNameFull: Dallas Labor Temple Association v. C. M. Cureton, Attorney General, etc.

opinions.text: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Texas. November 22, 1920. Dismissed with costs, pursuant to the tenth rule. Mr. Joseph Manson McCormick for appellants. Mr. C. M. Cureton for appellees.
